subject: 5 MC questions have wrong input types (insufficient radio choices)
body:
gp-mc-questions-have-choices found Q14 in RP1-4 and RP7 has type=multiple-choice but only 1 or 0 radio inputs:

- RP1 Q14 (rp1-q14): 1 radio input
- RP2 Q14 (rp2-q14): 1 radio input
- RP3 Q14 (rp3-q14): 1 radio input
- RP4 Q14 (rp4-q14): 1 radio input
- RP7 Q14 (rp7-q14): 0 radio inputs

MC questions need at least 2 radio inputs to present valid choices. Kai cannot answer these questions properly. Please add radio inputs with answer choices to these questions. RP5-6 and RP8-11 Q14s appear correct.
